name: APi Group Corporation
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow moat: statutorily required, recurring inspection/service/monitoring work and scale as a leading life-safety provider give route density and customer stickiness, but the work is labor-intensive and locally fragmented, barriers are low, and measured returns are still modest — ROIC proxy rose only from 2.9% (2022) to 7.7% (2025), not well above cost of capital through a cycle. Gross margin expansion 26.1% to 31.4% over 2022-2025 supports a 5, not a 7+.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 16.0%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 3.1x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Solid recurring-revenue services compounder, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% at $40.19 (weighted IRR 8.2%, IV@15% $17.24; even super bull is 13.0%); it clears 15% only near $17.24.
moat_for: Statutorily required fire/life-safety inspection, service and monitoring — recurring, non-discretionary demand
Scale and route density as a leading global life-safety provider (Chubb platform, 17+ countries)
Gross margin expansion 26.1% (2022) to 31.4% (2025) on mix shift to inspection/service/monitoring
Record backlog over $5B at Q2 2026 and diversified building/infrastructure end markets
moat_against: Fragmented local competition and low entry barriers in fire protection and specialty contracting
Labor-intensive services model — pricing power limited, wage pressure passes through slowly
ROIC proxy only 7.7% in 2025 after rising from 2.9% in 2022 — not yet proven above cost of capital through a cycle
Growth is acquisition-dependent (Chubb 2022, Onyx-Fire and WTech 2026) with goodwill/intangible-heavy balance sheet
